name: classcad-ai
description: ClassCAD AI monorepo — the training agent lives at the root; shared packages under packages/.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @classcad/skill -w @classcad/script -w @classcad/renderer && npm run build -w @awv-informatik/classcad-mcp -w @buerli.io/ai
scripts.test:reliability: npm run build -w @classcad/script -w @classcad/renderer -w @awv-informatik/classcad-mcp -w @buerli.io/ai && node packages/script/test/unit.mjs && node --test packages/script/test/diagnostics.mjs packages/script/test/lifecycle.mjs packages/script/test/inspection.mjs packages/script/test/session-contract.mjs packages/renderer/test/capture.mjs packages/mcp/test/queue-reliability.mjs scripts/test/run.mjs && node packages/renderer/test/smoke.mjs && node packages/renderer/test/golden.mjs
